text:
I thought it was going to be some genuine excuse, like you got called into a work emergency, or something that happened... But you were tired? You are going to lose your daughters if you continue to play favorites. No wonder the relationship is rocky. Kids aren't stupid, they surely know you don't treat them the same.

Be an adult, suck up the tiredness, have caffeine, and go to your daughter's birthday. This is a no brainer.

There shouldn't be IMPORTANT secrets between you and your wife. But this is not an important secret. It doesn't impact you or her or your relationship with one another. She's just butthurt that your friend confided in you, but her friends didn't confide in her.

Along with so, so many people here. Like I am really floored by the number of people who think stealing, simply because you can, is acceptable. 

There's no gray area. You knowingly stole. You know it. We know it. The only one who doesn't is the cashier and that doesn't give you free license to commit petty theft. Stop looking for validation. You are a thief, and not in an awesome way like in Skyrim.

It's ridiculous that you're not allowed to have your daughter for extended periods of time. You're a father, not a babysitter. Being an overprotective mama bear is going to do more harm than good for your daughter with her independence and other relationships.

I may not have said so before, but after reading that last comment about half your salary, yadada, you sound like a prick.

You expect your wife to be perfectly fine with your behavior. You know she's family now too, right jack ass?

I wouldn't be surprised if you ended up divorced.
